To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the oxygen binding of L. terrestis Hb requires the cooperative transitions of the heme pocket, subunit movement, intra-ring and inter ring contacts and the bracelet-assisted assembly.

(1) the cooperative ligand-binding of earthworm Hbs is achieved by a global movement of the subunits, (2) this global subunit movement is facilitated by intra-ring contacts, and (3) the additional electron densities in the X-ray structure are due to the sinusoidal bracelet.

L. terrestr is Hb adopts an unusual conformation with a sinusoidal bracelet in the native, oxygenated form, and this conformation is essential for the cooperative ligand-binding mechanism of the protein.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new mechanism of cooperative oxygen binding and a new structural motif of Hbs.
the cooperative oxygen-binding mechanism of L. terreristis Hb.
the structural basis of the cooperative oxygen binding of the earthworm Hb and provides the first structural evidence to support the bracelet-assisted assembly.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the bracelet-assisted inter-ring interactions are essential in facilitating cooperative oxygen binding of L. terrestris Hb, which provides a new insight into understanding the cooperative ligand-binding mechanisms of Hbs.

the oxygen binding cooperativity of L. terreristris Hb relies on the interplay among the tertiary and quaterny transitions in the hemes, the bracelet-assisted inter-ring contacts, and the inter-ring interactions.
the bracelet is essential for the assembly of Hb tetramer and plays a crucial role in the cooperativity of oxygen binding.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cooperative oxygen binding and assembly of L. terretris Hb are facilitated by the interplay of the tertiary and quaternaries transitions in the hemes and the intra- and inter-ring interactions.
the bracelet plays an essential role in facilitating the assembly and cooperativity of L. terretris Hb, which is the first structural evidence of such an effect.
the oxygen binding of L. terrestris Hb is cooperative and facilitated by the bracelet.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the bracelet-assisted inter-ring interactions are essential for cooperative ligand binding and assembly of the Hb molecule.
the cooperative ligands binding of L. terrestis Hb is achieved via a concerted movement of subunits, which are stabilized by the intra- and inter-ring contacts as well as the bracelet.
the cooperative oxygen binding is achieved through a series of concerted conformational changes, which is a general mechanism for the cooperative ligand-binding proteins.
